records.reason: Grants a 1-action activity that buffs a touched weapon for 1 round; the extra 2d6 spirit only applies against creatures of the opposed trait - resolved at the table, not a standing sheet value.
Impulse that creates a conjured figure which Grapples enemies; everything it does is target-side and resolved at the table.

Grants a real player resource - sanguimancy Hit Points (temp HP equal to your level after an 8-hour rest, cap 2x level, spendable to power other feats). No field expresses a named, level-scaling, daily-refreshed temp-HP pool; limitedUses tracks fixed per-day uses only.
Reaction at 0 HP that puts you into a vapor form for up to 1 minute; a table-resolved emergency reaction with no standing sheet value.
Area impulse: damages enemies and heals others. All effects land on targets/allies.

Expands your critical range to 19 on any weapon or unarmed attack you're legendary in - a genuine player-side attack change with no field; the registry records this style of rule-change as a strikeAttack situational (cf. supernatural-senses, keen-recollection).

situational.when: with a weapon or unarmed attack you have legendary proficiency in
situational.bonus: a natural 19 that would be a success is a critical success instead

records.reason: Reaction that downgrades a critical hit to a normal hit on a successful check; resolved at the table when it triggers.
Two-action Strike/Grapple activity; the MAP waiver applies only inside the activity, resolved at the table.
Reaction to Shove a foe who critically failed against you; the optional Intimidation-for-initiative only applies inside that reaction, so there is no standing modifier.

A conditional damage rider the player deals (1d6 persistent bleed on a critical hit made with a substituted Devise a Stratagem roll that dealt piercing or slashing). Nothing delivers it; matches registered riders like artery-map.

situational.when: on a critical hit with a Devised Stratagem attack dealing piercing or slashing

records.reason: Lowers the flat check to end persistent bleed from DC 15 to DC 10 (DC 5 with especially appropriate assistance) - the exact shape already registered for cindersoul, fire-lung and fire-savvy, but this feat has no entry.

situational.when: on the flat check to end persistent bleed damage
situational.bonus: DC 10 instead of 15 (DC 5 with especially appropriate assistance)

records.reason: Grants resistance to non-silver slashing equal to half your level while in hybrid or animal shape. The werecreature shape modes exist (cat-were-hybrid / cat-were-animal in src/rules/modes.ts) but carry no modifiers and nothing links this feat's resistance to them.

mode.name: Scarred Hide (hybrid or animal shape)
mode.duration: while in your hybrid or animal shape
mode.note: Werecreature: while in hybrid or animal shape you resist slashing damage equal to half your level; this resistance does not apply to silver weapons.

records.reason: Two-action Strike activity that temporarily alters the firearm's range/scatter and adds misfire conditions; entirely resolved at the table.
Action that damages a swarm sharing your familiar's space - target-side only.
Reshapes Fireball's area; an area/targeting change adjudicated at the table, not a sheet statistic.
Three-action Stride-and-Shove activity; the MAP handling is internal to the activity and resolved at the table.
Mythic area action that pushes and damages enemies against your class DC - target-side only.
Lets you substitute Society for Deciphering Writing and Identify Magic - exploration/downtime activities the app does not model, and no numeric change to any statistic.
Loosens which spell you may expend to Counterspell; a rules change applied when you use the reaction, not a sheet value.
Lets you redirect a countered spell at targets of your choice; entirely GM/table adjudication of a countered enemy spell.
Occultism substitutes for Diplomacy/Deception on Gather Information and Impersonate - social/downtime activities the app does not model; recognising cult members is flavour.
Spellshape that dazzles or blinds creatures that failed the spell's Reflex save - purely target-side.

Two player-side benefits with nothing delivering them: the persistent-fire flat check drops to DC 10 (DC 5 with assistance), and once per day you stay at 1 HP instead of being knocked out by a fire effect (becoming wounded 1) - a trackable daily use.

situational.when: on the flat check to end persistent fire damage
situational.bonus: DC 10 instead of 15 (DC 5 with appropriate assistance)

situational.when: the first time each day a fire effect would reduce you to 0 HP
situational.bonus: you remain at 1 HP and your wounded value increases by 1

records.reason: Area impulse dealing damage and creating hazardous terrain; all effects are target-side.
Action that makes fooled creatures off-guard - a condition applied to targets, adjudicated at the table.
Free action on Rage that damages nearby enemies; target-side only.

Upgrades the initiative bonus you gain from Scout from +1 to +2 - a bonus the player rolls, and initiative bonuses of exactly this shape are registered (ambush-awareness, swaggering-initiative, always-ready). Being able to Scout and Avoid Notice together is exploration mode and needs nothing.

situational.when: on initiative rolls when you used the Scout exploration activity

records.reason: Two-action Stride-and-Strike activity; the off-guard condition lands on the targets and MAP applies normally.

Grants 2 (3 at master, 4 at legendary spell DC) player-chosen temporary scrolls from your spellbook at every daily preparation - exactly the 'let them pick what the rules give them' case. There is a daily-item lane for alchemy (advancedAlchemy) but none for temporary scrolls, and no field can express a per-day count of player-chosen scrolls with rank limits.

Grants a player-chosen temporary 1st-rank scroll of any tradition each day (a second, 2nd-rank scroll at 8th level). Same missing lane as Scroll Adept - a daily temporary-scroll allotment the player picks; no existing field covers it.
Three-action activity that conjures a temporary level-0 item at the cost of 1 HP; a table-resolved creation with no standing statistic.
Free action on initiative to Stride into cover; movement resolved at the table.

Applies the off-guard condition to an enemy when it is in reach of you and two allies - a condition on the target, adjudicated at the table like flanking; the registry records no such 'gang-up' entries.

Explicitly removes the poppet flammable weakness to fire, which is exactly what removesWeaknesses exists for (cf. beastkin-resilience removing silver), but the feat carries no field so the weakness stays on the sheet.
An action that heals you or an adjacent creature and allows a flat check against persistent bleed; the healing is rolled at the table and the flat-check help applies to whoever was healed.

Grants an additional ikon - a pick the player must make. Ikons are an extra-choice group defined per class (ChoiceGroup.pickByLevel in src/rules/types.ts); no feat-level field increases an extra-choice pick count, and effectChoices cannot enumerate 'any ikon' (there is no featFilter).
Free action to draw a replacement or improvised shield after yours breaks; GM adjudicates what qualifies and the shield must still be Raised normally.
Mythic action to Recall Knowledge with expanded results about a creature; the information and lock-in are GM-adjudicated and target-side.
One-action Strike whose failure effect deals the other weapon's non-dice damage; resolved when the Strike is rolled.
Lets you choose to take Rage's temporary HP early at the cost of becoming fatigued afterward; a per-Rage choice made at the table, and the temp HP itself comes from Rage.
Spellshape that creates a delayed damaging circle against a basic Reflex save - purely target-side.

Undetected creatures of your level or lower become merely hidden while adjacent to you, which changes the flat check YOU roll to target them from impossible/undetected to DC 11. The registry records exactly these targeting flat-check changes (superior-sight, firesight, supernatural-senses); this feat has no entry.

situational.when: targeting an adjacent undetected creature of your level or lower
situational.bonus: it is only hidden from you (DC 11 flat check) rather than undetected

records.reason: Follow-up action that applies the grabbed condition to a foe you just hit - target-side condition.
Reaction to Step or Stride when your student crits; movement resolved at the table.
Action that lets a ranged Strike or Reload avoid provoking reactions from one foe; a table-resolved interaction with the enemy's reactions.
Lets you exclude up to 5 creatures from an area Heal or Harm; a targeting change resolved at the table.
Reaction that detonates your reduced companion for area damage against a save; target-side, and it consumes the companion rather than changing your sheet.
Triggered free action that gives you the effects of Illusory Disguise limited to your own living appearance; a disguise effect resolved at the table, with no per-day allotment or spell slot.
Three-action secret check the GM rolls against a target's Deception DC to learn information; entirely GM-adjudicated.

Willing allies within 60 feet that would be undetected by you are instead hidden, and your flat check to target hidden willing allies drops to DC 5 from 11 - a flat check the PLAYER rolls, the same shape as the registered fire-lung/superior-sight targeting entries. Nothing delivers it.

situational.when: to notice or target willing allies within 60 feet you're aware of
situational.bonus: they are hidden rather than undetected, and your flat check to target them is DC 5 instead of 11

records.reason: Only broadens when Cat's Luck may be triggered (also after an initiative roll) and still counts against its existing frequency; no statistic changes.
Reaction that makes one triggering attack target your Survival DC instead of your AC; a one-off substitution resolved at the table, not a standing AC change.
Reaction after a failed Seek that makes undetected creatures in the area hidden; a one-off detection outcome resolved at the table.

Grants a fly Speed (your land Speed, minimum 20 feet) while in sentinel form. The Sentinel Form mode exists (cat-sentinel-form in src/rules/modes.ts) but carries no modifiers and this feat adds nothing, so the fly Speed never appears.

mode.name: Sentinel's Orbit (sentinel form)
mode.note: Starlit Sentinel: while in sentinel form your fly Speed equals your land Speed, or 20 feet if that is higher.

records.reason: Spellshape that destroys one of your undead minions so the next necromancy spell doesn't expend its slot; a per-use, minion-dependent table decision with no standing slot change.
Strike that leaves the enemy off-guard against an ally's next attack - target-side condition benefiting allies.

An ikon whose immanence grants a free-action 10-foot teleport on a successful Strike and whose transcendence is a 3-action ability; both are activated abilities resolved at the table, with no standing statistic.
Extends Paired Link to six allies and lets linked allies cast touch spells at 30 feet - benefits that operate on allies' spellcasting.
Two-action Strike that attempts a counteract against a spell on the target using values derived from your existing level and class DC; entirely target-side and resolved at the table.
Two-action Strike that grants 80-foot reach for that attack and then teleports you or the target; a one-off activity resolved at the table, not a standing reach change.
